newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish 3-month WIBOR seen at 19.18 end-96.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish 3-month WIBOR seen at 19.18 end-96.

text.p: The Warsaw Interbank Offered Rate (WIBOR) for three-month deposits is expected to fall to 19.18 percent by the end of the year from 19.70 percent on Tuesday, a Reuter poll of Poland's 25 biggest banks showed.
The prediction is a mean average of banks' forecasts ranging from 18.40 percent to 19.75 percent.
Last month, banks saw the rate at 18.89 percent on average at the end of 1996.
It is seen at 19.54 percent on average this month and at 17.15 percent in November 1997.
Forecasts ranged between 19.00 and 20.0 percent and 15.50 and 18.70 percent, respectively.
